Overview

Corfu is a city in Ionian Islands with a population of 102,071. The Ionian’s emerald isle with a UNESCO Old Town, Venetian fortresses, and stunning turquoise beaches. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
